note: Douglas County park around 185-acre Lone Star Lake, southwest of Lawrence, on the site of the 1930s CCC camp that built the dam (stone water tower and fireplaces remain). 62 campsites in wooded loops above the north shore, 19 with electricity; restrooms, swim beach, boat ramp, shelters and a rentable community building. Permits in person from the camp host, check or cash only; quiet hours 10 p.m. to 6 a.m.; up to two shelters and eight people a site. --Claude
summary: County page (2026-11-06): 62 sites, 19 electric, $16 electric / $11 non-electric, FCFS, check or cash, April to mid-October, 14 days then 5 away. Fees widened to 11-16, max_stay 14 and site count added; season and booking re-sourced; water hookup cleared (county lists electric only). Showers left as stored (aggregators only). Lakeview kept. Phone 785-832-5293 not on the county page: propose camp host (785) 865-8466.
flags: PHONE (apply.py doesn't write it): stored 785-832-5293 isn't on the county page, and Google gives (785) 823-5293 (likely the same number with digits swapped; I couldn't confirm either). The county page gives the camp host '(785) 865-8466' for camping and Douglas County Maintenance 785-832-5296 for the community building. Propose (785) 865-8466.

WATERFRONT 'lakeview' kept: the campground is the wooded loops on the bench above the north shore. The lakeshore road, a beach area and 30-150 m of scattered trees and grass separate the sites from the water, so no lakefront; the northern loop looks onto the lake through open trees.
PIN 38.83713,-95.37436 is at the campground entrance on its south edge (= Google's campground point); the loops' centre is ~150 m NW (~38.8378,-95.3757). Under the 250 m threshold, not moved.

FEES widened from 16/16 to 11/16: the county's non-electric sites ($11) share the loops with the electric ones and nothing restricts them to tents; if the earlier pass meant to price EKKO at the electric rate only, keep the low at 16.
CLEARED hookups.water: the county lists electricity at 19 sites and no water hookups; Campendium's 'water' is an aggregator line. Electric not written (no amperage; aggregators say 20 A).
SHOWERS left as stored (true, derived): the county page says only 'restroom'; Campendium, The Dyrt, Hipcamp and Showermap list showers. Not re-sourced.
RATING: Google 4.5/97 (campground), 4.7/394 (park); RV Life no ratings.
SAND: none on the sites - grass and gravel under trees; the swim beach is day use.
